title: Trip Aggregate
description: Computed aggregates for a single vehicle trip. Produced by telematics-usage-ingestion and consumed by risk-scoring-engine, pricing-policy, and notification-advisory.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle that completed the trip.

event_count.description: Total number of telematics events recorded in this trip.

avg_speed_kmh.description: Average speed across all events in kilometres per hour.

max_speed_kmh.description: Maximum speed recorded during the trip in kilometres per hour.

harsh_braking_count.description: Total number of harsh braking events recorded during the trip.

hard_acceleration_count.description: Total number of events with acceleration_ms2 at or above the configured threshold.

distance_km.description: Total trip distance in kilometres computed from GPS trace.

trip_start.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the first event in the trip.

trip_end.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last event in the trip.
